subject: Adjusted weekend plans due to a travel disruption
text:
Hello,

I wanted to update you about the small gathering I had mentioned for this weekend. We were hoping to have a few people around for an early meal, but there has been an unexpected travel disruption affecting the regional line, and one guest may arrive very late or not at all.

Given the timing, I am considering moving the meal to Saturday afternoon instead of Friday evening, which might be easier for everyone and could reduce the need for late travel. If that works for you, we could keep the plan informal, with a simple lunch and a short walk if the weather is kind.

I would still prefer to keep noise levels modest, since I know some people may be resting over the weekend. I will send another note once I have confirmation from the others, but I wanted you to hear the likely change from me directly rather than by chance.

The alternative line is also showing delays, so parking and taxi availability near the station may be tighter than usual, which is part of why I want to be considerate about the revised timing and avoid a last-minute scramble if possible.

Thank you again for your patience and understanding, and please let me know if Saturday afternoon might be inconvenient.

Kind regards,
